title: 2026 TCS New York City Marathon becomes the first marathon ever to exceed 60,000-finisher mark
claims: The 2026 TCS New York City Marathon was held on Sunday, 1 November 2026.
The 2026 race had 61,529 starters and 61,146 finishers, breaking the world record for the largest marathon for the third consecutive year.
The 2026 field represented 153 countries, including 15,745 international finishers, with Italy having the highest number of non-US finishers followed by France.
The 2026 race celebrated 50 years of the five-borough course.
Men's open division champion Andreas Almgren of Sweden finished in 2:06:01, and women's open division champion Sheila Chepkirui of Kenya finished in 2:24:36.
Men's wheelchair champion Marcel Hug of Switzerland finished in 1:28:14, and women's wheelchair champion Catherine Debrunner of Switzerland finished in 1:40:02.
The nonbinary division winner was Ryan Montgomery of the USA in 2:23:39, a new course record in the nonbinary division.
There were 32,047 men's finishers, 28,942 women's finishers and 157 nonbinary finishers.
All finisher numbers and results are as of 1 November and subject to change after final race scoring verification.
